name: Downloader
description: Owns the download daemon the torrent-scout skill hands work to: aria2 on a systemd user unit (Linux), so a download outlives the agent turn, a gateway restart and a reboot. On every gateway start a guard repairs a config that would replay finished downloads (force-save) and starts the unit if it is installed but down; it never installs anything itself (that is scripts/downloader/setup.mjs). Talks only to aria2's JSON-RPC on 127.0.0.1. GATEWAY METHODS: downloader.status, downloader.add, downloader.remove, downloader.forget. Seeding is off: seed-time=0.

maxConcurrentDownloads.description: Downloads that run at once; the rest wait in the queue. Default 3.

unitName.description: systemd user unit name, without .service. Default torrent-scout-daemon.
